decision.rationale: TXN-008106 for 173.32 EUR at Ashgrove Apparel (MER-000033) is on card CRD-000067. It posted on 2026-08-14 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-25, 72 days later. That is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The merchant's order confirmation (DOC-000068) gives an expected delivery date of 2026-08-17. The dispute was opened 69 days after that date, so the 15-day wait in goods-not-received-wait has passed. The carrier's delivery record (DOC-000069) shows the parcel was delivered on 2026-08-17 to the cardholder's address in Tampere and signed for by O. Quinn. That matches the cardholder Olga Quinn of Tampere (CH-000056). Under goods-not-received-proof-of-delivery, the goods are treated as received and the dispute is declined. No document contained an instruction to whoever handles the dispute.

proposed_actions.reason: The carrier's record shows your Ashgrove Apparel order was delivered to your address in Tampere on 2026-08-17 and signed for by O. Quinn. Under our policy, the goods are therefore treated as received.
